Statistical methods
We transformed the variables S and AE to common logarithms. Then we performed
univariate and bivariate linear regressions and calculated the usual statistics: intercepts,
coefficients, probabilities, and R
2-values. We excluded Hawaii from the regression
analyses for Amphibia and Reptilia because these classes are not found in that zoological
region.
